LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE COMPANY'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT OR IN THE ALTERNATIVE SUMMARY ADJUDICATION. MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS DENIED. THE OBJECTION TO THE KOEHN DECLARATION IS SUSTAINED. EVEN IF THE COURT HAS ACCEPTED THE CONTENTS OF THE CLAIMS FILED THERE IS A TRIABLE ISSUE OF MATERIAL FACT PHRASED IN THE FRANGIAMORE DECLARATION INCLUDING THE EVIDENCE OFFERED BY PLAINTIFF IN HIS DECLARATION. MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION AS TO PUNITIVE DAMAGES IS LIKEWISE DENIED. PER DIEM FEES ASSESSED BY THE COURT. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER PURSUANT TO CCP 437 C(G).
